name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedEval.subtract_identity
title: Masked evaluator minus BGG+ constrained-key evaluation = mask + value * sG + noise
statement: For BGG+ encodings c_i = s(A_i - x_i G) + e_i (a BV15-type constrained key for the attribute x) and a masked evaluator O(z) = s EvalF(f_z, A) + P(stmt z) + eta(z) (master function plus a per-statement mask P), the difference O(z) - EvalCt(f_z, c) equals P(stmt z) + f_z(x) (sG) + (eta(z) - e_{f_z}). At points with f_z(x) = 0 this is the decryption of the masked-evaluator witness PRF; at the other points the deviation is the canonical term sG.
